![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

When flat-mapping over `refs` to collect `pageAssetRefs`, we should normalize `ref.page_asset_refs` using `asArray` and filter out non-record entries to prevent potential `TypeError`s if `page_asset_refs` is null, undefined, or not an array.

```javascript
  const pageAssetRefs = refs.flatMap((ref) => asArray(ref?.page_asset_refs).filter(isRecord));
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. When processing collections of assets or inputs, normalize the input using an array helper (e.g., `asArray`) and filter out non-record entries before mapping or flat-mapping over them to prevent TypeErrors on null, undefined, or non-array inputs.
</details>

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

When indexing page assets into a map by `ms_page_asset_id`, we should ensure only entries with a non-empty ID string are indexed to prevent malformed or empty keys.

```javascript
  const byAssetId = new Map(asArray(pageScreenshotAssets?.page_assets)
    .filter((asset) => isRecord(asset) && isNonEmptyString(asset.ms_page_asset_id))
    .map((asset) => [asset.ms_page_asset_id, asset]));
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. When indexing assets or records into a map/object by an ID, normalize the input collection using an array helper (e.g., `asArray`), filter out non-record entries, and ensure only entries with a non-empty ID string are indexed to prevent malformed or empty keys.
</details>

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

Update the `upstream_validators_pass` check to explicitly verify that all expected validator keys are present and have the correct status.

```javascript
    check('upstream_validators_pass', (
      isRecord(manifest.upstream_validator_status) 
      && expectedValidatorKeys.every((key) => manifest.upstream_validator_status[key] === 'pass')
    )),
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. When validating upstream status objects, explicitly verify that all expected validator keys are present and have the correct status rather than checking only the values of the present keys. Ensure there are regression tests that delete expected validator keys to verify the system fails closed.
</details>

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

When destructuring function parameters, destructure from `params || {}` rather than relying solely on parameter defaults like `function foo({ bar } = {})` if the function can be called with an explicit `null`. This prevents a destructuring `TypeError` and allows the `null` input to reach internal validation logic.

```javascript
export function writePostAttemptMsQuestionLevelSourceViewAssetArtifacts(options) {
  const { outRoot, artifacts } = options || {};
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. When destructuring function parameters, destructure from `params || {}` rather than relying solely on parameter defaults like `function foo({ bar } = {})` if the function can be called with an explicit `null`. This prevents a destructuring `TypeError` and allows the `null` input to reach internal validation logic.
</details>

body: Fixed in a5ead42e7. `recomputeSummary` now normalizes `ref?.page_asset_refs` through `asArray(...).filter(isRecord)` before flat-mapping/counting refs.
Fixed in a5ead42e7. `blockersByGroup` now normalizes blockers with `asArray`, filters to records, and requires a non-empty `question_group_key` before indexing.
Fixed in a5ead42e7. The page-asset lookup now indexes only record assets with a non-empty `ms_page_asset_id`.
Fixed in a5ead42e7. The validator now records upstream diagnostics and fails closed for missing/malformed locator and page-screenshot inputs, including invalid `rows` and `page_assets` array fields.
Fixed in a5ead42e7. Upstream validator status validation now explicitly requires both expected keys and requires each value to be `pass`.
Fixed in a5ead42e7. The `upstream_validators_pass` check now uses the same expected-key validation instead of relying on present values only.
Fixed in a5ead42e7. `writePostAttemptMsQuestionLevelSourceViewAssetArtifacts` now destructures from `options || {}` so explicit `null` reaches the intended validation error path.

+function makePageAsset({ pageIndex, sourcePdfSha256 = SHA_A, imageSha256 = SHA_B } = {}) {

+    binary_retention: {

+        `npm run method-map:build-post-attempt-ms-page-screenshot-assets -- --ms-document-id=${DOC_A} --source-pdf-sha256=${sourcePdfSha256} --pdf-page-index-zero-based=${pageIndex}`,
+      source_pdf_sha256: sourcePdfSha256,

+describe('post-attempt MS question-level source-view assets', () => {
